newsitem.title: USA: Genzyme has 99 percent of Neozyme units.
newsitem.headline: Genzyme has 99 percent of Neozyme units.

text.p: Genzyme Corp said on Tuesday that 2.4 million units of Neozyme II Corp, or 98.8 percent of the total outstanding, had been tendered in response to its offer of $45 cash per unit.
The offer and withdrawal rights expired October 28, Genzyme said.
It said 2,385,561 units were tendered and accepted for payment, including 673,153 tendered by guarantees of delivery.

Each Neozyme unit consists of one share of callable common stock, one callable warrant to purchase two shares of Genzyme General Division common, and 0.135 share of Genzyme Tissue Repair Division common.
Neozyme shareholders who have not tendered their units will be entitled to receive $29 cash for each share of Neozyme callable common.

The callable warrants included in the untendered units will become exercisable on the effective date of the merger of the companies. The exercise price will be equal to the average closing price of two shares of Genzyme General Division common stock and 0.135 share of Genzyme Tissue Repair Division common stock over the 20 trading days prior to the effective date of the merger.
Neozyme conducts research, development and clinical testing of products for the treatment of cystic fibrosis under contract with Genzyme, a biotechnology company.
